scope: Read-only review of the ten overdue open follow-up actions surfaced by docs:check during Phase 4 local release certification.

reviews.finding: No current same-date storage metrics and deployment inventory were collected in this pass. The existing request still requires those owner-held operational observations.
reviews.next_step: Deployment maintainer records actual storage totals and deployment inventory for the same date range, preserving active aliases and rollback capacity.

reviews.finding: Phase 4 adds lifecycle tests and safe queued-expiry release, but does not define bounded retention for queued/failed payloads or expired receipts. Ambiguous receipts remain retained and are not replayed.
reviews.next_step: Image maintainer defines privacy- and idempotency-safe retention and tests cleanup for accepted, expired, and ambiguous operations before activation.

reviews.finding: The local authentication/session suite passed, but this pass did not audit all production administrator credential dependencies or hosted role configuration.
reviews.next_step: Identity maintainer inventories remaining administrator-only paths and verifies least-privilege credentials independently of public Auth verification.

reviews.finding: Current source-bound image/accounting/deployment guidance was reconciled and impact output was inspected. Generated indexes contain the only unmapped changed paths. Other registered-domain attestations remain stale until their explicit reviews are recorded.
reviews.next_step: Documentation maintainer continues weekly source-bound guide reviews, updates content when behavior changes, and records evidence before refreshing fingerprints.

reviews.finding: Local auth/session tests passed. Durable device approval/poll RPC ownership and one-time-consumption database acceptance remains unverified because the disposable PostgreSQL runtime could not start.
reviews.next_step: Keep legacy elevation closed and complete device-grant RLS, ownership, expiry, and one-time-consumption tests against disposable PostgreSQL.

reviews.finding: The earlier refreshed-profile availability observation remains nonreproduced. No hosted Auth or private lookup diagnostics were inspected in this local pass.
reviews.next_step: If the symptom recurs, retain allowlisted status/timing and correlate private Auth/lookup evidence; otherwise preserve the evidence-backed nonrecurrence disposition.

reviews.finding: Local build, route/security, and rendered boundary checks are in scope; production digest correlation and the original authenticated Images/Sites acceptance matrix were not performed.
reviews.next_step: Release maintainer privately correlates the reported digest and completes deployed authenticated Images/Sites recovery acceptance.

reviews.finding: No signed-in production generation/library/download request was made. Allowance values remain unapproved, hosted authorization is unaudited, and local tests do not establish deployed capacity.
reviews.next_step: After approval and release authorization, verify fresh capability and complete signed-in production generation, durable library/Favorites, and download acceptance without replaying unknown work.

reviews.finding: Phase 4 image allowance work does not establish caller distribution or deliberate continuation with owner-scoped revision-aware checkpoints for the separate relay/SDK contract.
reviews.next_step: Relay/SDK maintainer completes compatible caller distribution and deliberate continuation/checkpoint acceptance; do not infer provider hard spend caps.

reviews.finding: The local auth/session regression suite passed, but real provider/email callbacks, account switching, physical browser history restoration, and failed-revocation browser acceptance were not exercised.
reviews.next_step: Security/access maintainer completes the explicit external-provider and original-browser acceptance matrix; retain session authority and revocation checks.

limitations: No production or hosted resource was queried or mutated for this action review.
Docker/PostgreSQL unavailability blocks runtime migration, RLS, grant, reservation, and concurrency certification.
The review deadlines are extended one week for the next evidence-backed review; no action was closed or accepted.
